learn.title: Learn · How to use
learn.step1: Create a deck from any resource or note.
learn.step2: Study with spaced repetition to remember long-term.
learn.step3: Track your progress with the KPIs at the top.

agents.title: Agents · How to use
agents.step1: Create an agent and describe what it should do.
agents.step2: Give it access to your resources and skills.
agents.step3: Chat with it or trigger it from an automation.

automations.title: Automations · How to use
automations.step1: Pick a trigger: schedule, event or manual.
automations.step2: Choose the agent or action to run.
automations.step3: Check the Runs section to see results.

github.title: GitHub · How to use
github.step1: Connect a repository to sync issues and milestones.
github.step2: Track work on the Kanban and Gantt views.
github.step3: Changes sync back to GitHub automatically.

calendar.title: Calendar · How to use
calendar.step1: Connect a calendar or create events directly.
calendar.step2: Link events to projects and resources.
calendar.step3: Get reminders for what's coming up.

pipelines.title: Pipelines · How to use
pipelines.step1: Create a pipeline and add a stage for each step of your flow.
pipelines.step2: An agent is an AI with instructions that processes each card. Assign one to a stage, or use Many — and create a new agent right from the stage settings.
pipelines.step3: Drop cards in; agents run automatically or on demand, and you track activity and runs.

home.title: Your workspace
home.step1: Create a note or import a file to begin.
home.step2: Open a project to keep related work together.
home.step3: Configure your AI provider in Settings when you want to work with Many.

library.title: Your library
library.step2: Group related sources in folders and projects.
library.step3: Open a source to read, annotate or ask Many about it.

projects.title: Give your work context
projects.step1: Create a project for a topic or goal.
projects.step2: Add the files and notes you need.
projects.step3: Switch projects to focus on the right context.

people.title: Keep relationships in context
people.step1: Add a contact and their details.
people.step2: Link notes and conversations to that person.
people.step3: Record the next action while the context is fresh.

email.title: Your conversations, connected
email.step1: Connect your email account in Settings.
email.step2: Open a conversation to read and draft a reply.
email.step3: Review recipients and content before sending.

social.title: Plan your publications
social.step1: Connect the social accounts you want to use.
social.step2: Draft a post and review it before publishing.
social.step3: Cloud publishing needs a plan that includes it; check access in Settings.

workflows.title: Build a repeatable process
workflows.step1: Create a workflow with a clear outcome.
workflows.step2: Connect the steps and select their tools.
workflows.step3: Run it and inspect the results before scheduling it.

runs.title: Understand what happened
runs.step1: Open a run to see its progress and result.
runs.step2: Inspect tool calls when something needs attention.
runs.step3: Use the result to refine your agent or workflow.

marketplace.title: Extend your workspace
marketplace.step1: Browse the available agents, skills and extensions.
marketplace.step2: Read what an item does before installing it.

chat.title: Work with Many
chat.step1: Choose an AI provider in Settings.
chat.step2: Describe a task and attach the relevant sources.
chat.step3: Review the response and any actions that need approval.

transcriptions.title: Turn audio into notes
transcriptions.step1: Choose a transcription engine in Settings.
transcriptions.step2: Start a recording and grant microphone access when asked.
transcriptions.step3: Review the transcript and save or export the result.

settings.title: Make Dome yours
settings.step1: Manage your account and access here.
settings.step2: Choose AI providers and connect your services when needed.
settings.step3: Workspace modes organize tools independently of your plan.

tags.title: Find work by topic
tags.step1: Create tags for themes you revisit.
tags.step3: Use tags to find sources across projects.

editor.title: A place to think
editor.step1: Write your first note or add content.
editor.step2: Link the sources that support your ideas.
editor.step3: Use Many when you need help developing the material.

setup.subtitle: Let’s get you started
setup.cloud_description: Keep your work available across devices with cloud access included in your plan.
